description: This file defines the Configuration class within the SuiteCRMity namespace, implementing ArrayAccess to manage configuration settings by interacting with an internal container. It loads configuration data from an external Configurator class and provides methods to get, set, check, and unset configuration options.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class that manages configuration settings, implementing ArrayAccess for array-like access to configuration options, loading data from an external Configurator class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object by loading configuration data from the Configurator class.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a given offset, throws exception if offset is null or not found.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a configuration offset exists.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given configuration offset, or null if not set.
